game_title: Frequency Bazaar – Ice Cave Shelter Defense
game_concept: A action defense set in Frost Peaks – Ice Cave Shelter, a shelter in an ice cave: the mountaineer must handle falling rocks while practicing strings & dictionaries. Core idea – Frequency Bazaar: Count how often each item appears using a dictionary.
theme: Frost Peaks – Ice Cave Shelter: a shelter in an ice cave
core_gameplay_loop: In Ice Cave Shelter, repeat each round: Count how often each item appears using a dictionary. Each round, falling rocks strike the flag pole, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the tally value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Protect the flag pole from falling rocks in Ice Cave Shelter: keep the tally meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 76-second timer ends.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
lose_condition: tally drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 76-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 8 – Strings & Dictionaries | Level 9 (extended tier): Frequency Bazaar
assets_style: towering pixel-art mountains: glaciers, jagged ice ridges, crisp white and cyan with deep blue shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; thin howling wind, high strings and ice-crack stings
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Frequency Bazaar' (Week 8 slot 9), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Ice Cave Shelter'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how tally changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against falling rocks in Ice Cave Shelter.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 76 seconds while tally > 0.
